'''Billy Pemerton''' (also published as '''Billy Permerton''') is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2001 Tennessee State Championship]] on 12 May 2001 with [[Mind What You Have Learned / Save You It Can|MWYHL Old SKool Asteroids]], according to Michael Crosby's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2294">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-13-t-shirt-player-at-tn-states-5-12-01d2294/ t-shirt-player-at-tn-states-5-12-01], DeckTech (Michael "Cantonavader" crosby, 13 May 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-13-t-shirt-player-at-tn-states-5-12-01d2294/ GitHub Pages].</ref> As Billy Permerton he played at [[April 2001 Cookeville tournament (28 April)]] on 28 April 2001 with Jabba's Palace with Thrawn and Flagship Executor, according to Mike Wudhapitak's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2181">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-29-cookeville-tennessee-4-28-01d2181/ cookeville-tennessee-4-28-01], DeckTech (Mike "Anime Knight" Wudhapitak, 29 April 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-29-cookeville-tennessee-4-28-01d2181/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
